source.note: Boulevard City's Kingdom Arena look as one material: the four looks of arenaMaterials chosen per vertex by the part the model bakes into its vertex colour alpha (0 cladding, 1/3 glazing, 2/3 roof, 1 raised roof), as Boulevard's palm.js branches on its baked kind, so the arena is one draw. Beige panels with 1.5 m joints, dark glazing with mullions (clearcoat on High), a standing-seam roof, a white membrane; at night the glazing glows warm and a wash lights the cladding from the base. The raised roof's sheen is left out.
